column3: MT 32:11. “I am unworthy of” renders “I am smaller than,” and “lovingkindness” renders “hesed” (plural).
MT 32:21. “appease him” renders “cover his face,” and “he will accept me” renders “he will lift up my face.”
MT 32:29. “Israel” is explained by “you have striven with God.”
MT 32:31. “Peniel” means “face of God,” and “my life” renders “my soul.”
